feedback.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-1)\cdot 2-2\cdot (-1) \\  & =-2+2 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,0\,|=0
$$
